'''''Yander 3''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] aligned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was present at the [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34]], and was carrying foodstuff.
